applies_why: This judge text grounds an UNDERDETERMINED outcome on the text not naming whose body is the channel.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: does not state a link or its contrary: read as (1) absence of an explicit statement in a verse makes the point UNDERDETERMINED, or (2) such absence may not be a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
why: The judge treats the absence of an explicit naming in the verse as making the point open, which K-S2 forbids as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
